title.zh: 为什么要缓存，为什么不止一级
title.en: Why caches, and why more than one level

description.zh: 存储越大越慢；几级缓存叠起来，让大部分访问在最近的一级办完。用 Zen 5 的真实延迟和重用距离算平均每次访问的周期。
description.en: Bigger storage is slower; stacked levels let most accesses finish in the nearest one. Average cycles per access from Zen 5's documented latencies and reuse distance.

zh: 为什么 CPU 要有三级缓存
为什么缓存不能做得又大又快
en: why caches cannot be big and fast

description.zh: 64 字节一行；地址切成标记、组号、行内偏移；直接映射的玩具缓存上两个数组互相挤掉。
description.en: 64-byte lines; an address splits into tag, index and offset; two arrays evict each other in a direct-mapped toy cache.

zh: 标记 组号 偏移

title.en: Associativity and the three kinds of miss

description.zh: 直接映射、组相联、全相联；用 Hill 的办法把缺失分成强制、容量、冲突，在同一个程序上扫容量和路数。
description.en: Direct-mapped, set-associative and fully associative; Hill's method splits misses into compulsory, capacity and conflict, swept over size and ways on one program.

zh: 强制缺失 容量缺失 冲突缺失

title.zh: 满了换谁：LRU、伪 LRU 与 RRIP

description.zh: 组满了换谁；比缓存稍大的循环让 LRU 一次不中；树形伪 LRU、随机、SRRIP、BRRIP 和 Belady 最优。
description.en: Which line to evict; a loop slightly bigger than the cache defeats LRU; tree pseudo-LRU, random, SRRIP, BRRIP and Belady's optimum.

title.en: Write-back, write-through and the write buffer

description.zh: 两种写法、写分配、脏位和写缓冲；四种策略各读写多少字节，写缓冲多深核心才不用等。
description.en: Two ways to write, write-allocate, the dirty bit and the write buffer; bytes moved under four policies and how deep the buffer must be.

title.zh: 三级各管什么：包含、排他与共享 L3
title.en: What each level does: inclusive, exclusive and the shared L3

description.zh: L1 分指令和数据、L2 私有、L3 共享切片；包含、非包含、排他三种关系下两级能装多少；Zen 5、Lion Cove、Neoverse V3、Apple M6 的真实配置。
description.en: Split L1, private L2, sliced shared L3; how much two levels hold when inclusive, non-inclusive or exclusive; the real configurations of Zen 5, Lion Cove, Neoverse V3 and Apple M6.

zh: 私有 L2 共享 L3

title.zh: 为什么 L1 这么小

description.zh: L1 用虚拟地址选组、物理地址比标记；组号要落在页内偏移里，容量就卡在页大小 × 路数。
description.en: L1 picks a set with virtual bits and compares physical tags; the index must sit inside the page offset, so size stops at page size × ways.

zh: 为什么 L1 缓存这么小
en: L1 size limit page size times ways
why is L1 cache so small

description.zh: 硬件预取器怎么猜下一行；按指令记步长的预取表；覆盖率和准确率，链表为什么预取不了。
description.en: How hardware prefetchers guess the next line; the per-instruction stride table; coverage and accuracy, and why linked lists defeat it.

zh: 预取覆盖率 准确率

title.en: A first look at MESI, and false sharing

description.zh: 一行在两个核心里各有一份时的 MESI 状态；两个不相干的计数器挤在同一行，行在核心之间来回搬。
description.en: The MESI states of one line held by two cores; two unrelated counters in one line make the line bounce between cores.

zh: 两个核心写同一缓存行
en: two cores writing one cache line

title.zh: 追指针：看得见的缓存台阶
title.en: Pointer chasing: the cache staircase you can measure

description.zh: 随机链表追指针，延迟随工作集一级级上跳；4 KiB 页让 L2 提前缺失，大页让各组均匀；查看本机缓存的命令。
description.en: Chasing a random chain, latency steps up level by level; 4 KiB pages make L2 miss early and huge pages even out the sets; commands to read your own caches.

title.zh: 缓存的前沿（2026 年 11 月）

description.zh: 叠在芯片下面的 3D V-Cache、服务器和 AI 芯片的几百 MB 大缓存、SRAM 几乎不再缩小，按证据强弱分类并注明日期。
description.en: 3D V-Cache stacked under the die, server and AI chips with hundreds of MB of cache, SRAM that has nearly stopped shrinking; sorted by strength of evidence, with dates.

title.zh: 看一颗芯片的缓存时问三件事
title.en: Three questions about a chip's caches

description.zh: 每级多大几路几个周期、哪几级共享与包含关系、程序的访问有没有规律。
description.en: How big, how many ways and how many cycles at each level; which levels are shared and how they include each other; whether the program's accesses have a pattern.

zh: 怎么看 CPU 缓存参数
en: how to read CPU cache specs

label.zh: 组号选出一组，再在组里比标记
label.en: The index picks a set; the tag is compared within it

reason.zh: 第 3 章的组相联缓存沿用第 2 章把地址拆成标记、组号、偏移的办法，只是每组放进几路。
reason.en: Chapter 3’s set-associative cache keeps chapter 2’s split of an address into tag, index and offset, with several ways per set.

label.en: A full set needs a victim

reason.zh: 第 4 章的替换策略只在第 3 章那种组已满、又来了新行时才起作用，比较的也是第 3 章的缺失次数。
reason.en: Chapter 4’s policies act only when a set from chapter 3 is full and a new line arrives, and they are compared by chapter 3’s miss counts.

label.zh: 组号和偏移要落在页内
label.en: Index and offset must fit inside the page offset

reason.zh: 第 7 章的上限「容量 ≤ 页大小 × 路数」来自第 2 章：组号加偏移的位数不能超出页内偏移。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s limit, size ≤ page × ways, comes from chapter 2: the index and offset bits must stay inside the page offset.

label.zh: 预取的行也要熬过 LRU

reason.zh: 第 8 章预取距离超过 4 步就全部失效，原因是第 4 章的 LRU：一行预取要比 2(d−1) 个更新的行活得久，8 路装不下。
reason.en: Chapter 8’s prefetching fails from distance 5 on because of chapter 4’s LRU: a prefetched line must outlive 2(d−1) newer lines, more than 8 ways hold.

reason.zh: 第 9 章的伪共享发生，是因为第 2 章的 64 字节缓存行是缓存搬运和记账的最小单位，两个变量同在一行就会互相作废。
reason.en: Chapter 9’s false sharing happens because chapter 2’s 64-byte line is the unit caches move and track, so two variables in one line invalidate each other.

reason.zh: 第 6 章讲三级怎样分工、包含与排他各给多少容量，接着第 1 章按重用距离算出的每级命中份额。
reason.en: Chapter 6’s division of labour and the capacity inclusion or exclusion gives build on chapter 1’s per-level hit shares from reuse distance.

label.en: Each step is one level’s latency

reason.zh: 第 10 章追指针测出的延迟台阶，正是第 1 章表里各级缓存和内存的延迟。
reason.en: Chapter 10’s pointer-chase staircase measures the latencies of chapter 1’s table, one level per step.

reason.zh: 第 10 章在 1 MiB 处多出的周期是第 3 章的冲突缺失：4 KiB 页的随机物理页框让部分 L2 组装不下。
reason.en: Chapter 10’s extra cycles at 1 MiB are chapter 3’s conflict misses: random 4 KiB physical frames overload some L2 sets.

label.zh: 把延迟梯子的每一格拆开
label.en: Opening each rung of the latency ladder

reason.zh: 第 1 章从《为什么计算一直在等内存》第 2 章的延迟梯子出发，再拆开每一级缓存。
reason.en: Chapter 1 starts from the latency ladder in chapter 2 of “Why Compute Waits for Memory” and opens each cache level.

label.en: Rows are fast because whole lines move

reason.zh: 第 2 章的 64 字节缓存行解释《为什么计算一直在等内存》第 2 章按行与按列遍历的差别。
reason.en: Chapter 2’s 64-byte line explains the row-versus-column difference in chapter 2 of “Why Compute Waits for Memory”.

reason.zh: 第 1 章的三级平均访问时间用的是《为什么计算一直在等内存》第 4 章的一般算法。
reason.en: Chapter 1’s three-level average access time uses the general formula from chapter 4 of “Why Compute Waits for Memory”.

label.en: Tile when data outgrows the cache

reason.zh: 第 10 章写代码的建议里，数据超过缓存时的分块见《为什么计算一直在等内存》第 3 章。
reason.en: Chapter 10’s coding advice sends tiling for data larger than the cache to chapter 3 of “Why Compute Waits for Memory”.

label.zh: 从「旁边放一小块快存储」讲起

reason.zh: 《一堆开关是怎么学会算数的》第 11 章只用一句话说真实处理器在旁边放了缓存；这一篇第 1 章讲为什么要放、为什么分三级。
reason.en: Chapter 11 of “How a Pile of Switches Learned to Do Arithmetic” says in one line that real processors keep a cache nearby; chapter 1 here explains why, and why three levels.
